summary_en: Chubu Shiryo will acquire up to 1.1 million shares (3.83% of outstanding shares) for up to 2.6 billion yen via ToSTNeT-3 on November 2, 2026, at the closing price on October 30, 2026, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Chubu Shiryo announced a treasury stock acquisition to be executed via ToSTNeT-3 on November 2, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. Japan Standard Time. The company will acquire up to 1.1 million shares, representing 3.83% of outstanding shares (28.7 million shares as of September 30, 2026), for up to 2.6 billion yen. The acquisition price will be set at the closing price on October 30, 2026, with details to be confirmed after the closing price is determined.

The acquisition is to be executed as a single off-hours transaction with a submission deadline of 8:45 a.m. on November 2, 2026. This is a block execution to a specific institutional shareholder already holding treasury stock policy positions. Results will be announced immediately after the trading session ends on that date.

The company stated the purpose as enhancing shareholder returns and improving capital efficiency. This follows the authorization of the stock buyback framework previously approved by the Board of Directors.
